summary: FBRX 2.1 Beta: home from anywhere. FBRX VPN through your FBRX Gate, your FBRX Server's bigger AI in your chats, a remote desktop to the server, a calendar of your own, and a password keeper.
notes: FBRX VPN (Orbit → FBRX VPN): connect to your FBRX Gate from anywhere with the settings it makes for this computer, then Check home to see your server answer.

Think with your FBRX Server's AI: AI models → Your other computers' AI → Use for chats. Fabrix keeps its tools, memory and approvals on your computer; only the thinking happens on the server, at home or over FBRX VPN. Each answer shows how long it took.
Remote desktop to FBRX Server: its console with a command line beside it (SSH), full screen or in its own window.

The FBRX calendar: add your own events, repeating if you like, tied to a project, note, task or automation and colored to match. Your tasks, project deadlines and automations show on it too; Outlook and calendar links stay as add-ons. New Month view.
The Vault is a password keeper: save a sign-in from anywhere (the password generator, Fabrix, the browser), and FBRX Browser fills sign-ins in from it.

Fabrix fits the AI you choose: a small local model gets a short, focused list of tools; a big one sees them all. Memory rides with your message so providers can reuse their work, and local models answer sooner.
Names: the Bridge section is now Glass, and FBRX Glass is now Dash.
Setup opens with what it does, and DEVELOPING.md explains how FBRX is built for anyone who wants to change it.

server.summary: FBRX Server 1.2: FBRX Command as a role, a gate you can VPN into, and an AI it lends to your computers.
notes: FBRX Command is a server role: add it at install or from the console, and the server's own roles join it.
FBRX Gate lets FBRX VPN devices with full access reach the server's console, SSH and FBRX Mesh, and its Add a device result explains how an FBRX computer uses the settings.
With the ai role, paired computers can think with the server's own model (never a cloud provider), under the same lending setting and Help with AI permission as Mesh Assist.
From 1.1: sudo fbrx-server update check, then sudo fbrx-server update commit.

command.summary: FBRX Command 2.1: runs as an FBRX Server role.
notes: On an FBRX Server, FBRX Command runs as a role the server manages (and updates with the server); the server's own roles can join it from the console.
From 2.0: invitations without a website, support passes, and billing, licenses and the Black Hole add-on in one place.
